During frames 1–2, another worker is positioned about 1.5–2 m away on the right and slightly beneath the wearer, facing left toward the brick ledge; his torso and extended right arm, approximately 1.2–1.5 m distant, appear mid-grey. Relative to the sunlit textures in RGB, this map makes both the severe vertical drop to the ground and the crisp 90-degree corner formed by the left wall and forward brick course readily measurable.
